brief: 5 things that actually close enterprise deals — from a 7-figure sales leader.

slots.author: Jordan Vale
slots.headline: 5 Things That Actually Close Enterprise Deals
slots.body: I’ve closed $10M+ in SaaS contracts. These five levers separate top performers from everyone else.

slots.author: Jordan Vale
slots.title: Stop Pitching, Start Diagnosing
slots.body: Most reps lead with features. Top reps lead with curiosity. The best discovery call beats the best demo every time.

slots.author: Jordan Vale
slots.title: Map The Power Map
slots.body: Know every stakeholder, their KPIs, and their personal win. If you don't know who can kill the deal, you haven't started.

slots.author: Jordan Vale
slots.title: Quantify The Cost of Inaction
slots.body: Build a business case with numbers the CFO trusts. ROI isn't a slide; it's the only thing that gets contracts signed.

slots.author: Jordan Vale
slots.title: Co-Create The Evaluation Plan
slots.body: Never leave the process to chance. Define milestones, mutual commitments, and what 'yes' looks like before the proposal ever goes out.

slots.author: Jordan Vale
slots.title: Sell Outcomes, Not Features
slots.body: Buyers don't need more tools. They need a guaranteed outcome. Make your contract the lowest-risk option on their table.

slots.author: Jordan Vale
slots.title: Secure The Internal Champion
slots.body: A deal without a champion is just a quote. Equip someone inside to sell for you when you're not in the room.

slots.author: Jordan Vale
slots.headline: Which Lever Will You Pull First?
slots.body: Drop your best closing tactic in the comments. I'd love to hear what's working for you right now.
